description: 任意の2軸以上(プロダクトリスク／テスト観点カテゴリ／ペルソナ／機能ID／シナリオ／テストコンテナ／パラメータ／テストタイプなど)を汎用の軸データとして受け取り、軸ペアの直積表を決定的に生成して、空行・空列(片側にしかない要素)を列挙する。3軸以上なら全組合せの軸ペアを一括で回す。充填率は分母を明示して算出し、軸母集団の縮退とテストベース本文の裏付けまで併せて照合するため、見かけの高充填率を検出できる。各リンク宣言の根拠(evidence)が documents 本文から裏付けられるかまで照合し、根拠裏付け後の充填率を併記する。design_* 系エンジンが発行するコロン区切りの網羅対象ID（BV:/EP:/ST:/DT:/PW:/SC:/UC:/DL:/CFG:）も既定でID索引に含める。

axes.description: Two or more axes to be crossed; axes are plain input data, no axis-kind specific behavior

axisId.description: Axis id, unique across axes, e.g. RISK / PERSPECTIVE / PERSONA

axisName.description: Axis display name, e.g. プロダクトリスク

derivationKind.description: Set to "derived" when this item is an analytical product derived from the test basis (e.g. a product risk item or a test condition synthesized from requirements) and therefore does not appear verbatim in the basis text by design. When set, CMX-10 verbatim id/label grounding is skipped for this item; instead derivationQuote is required and is checked against documents (missing/too short -> CMX-18[high], not found in documents -> CMX-19[high]).

derivationQuote.description: Verbatim excerpt from documents that this item was derived from. Required when derivationKind is "derived" and documents are supplied.

id.description: Item id, unique across all axes

links.description: Links to items on other axes; links are treated as undirected. Plain strings are accepted for backward compatibility but carry no evidence

anyOf.description: Target item id on another axis (legacy form, no evidence)

evidence.description: Verbatim quote from documents that substantiates this link; missing evidence is flagged as CMX-16[high] and evidence absent from documents as CMX-17[high]

evidenceSource.description: Where the evidence came from (document name / heading / upstream tool); display only

targetId.description: Target item id on another axis

axisPairs.description: Axis pairs to audit; when omitted, all i<j combinations of axes are audited

completedTools.description: Already executed tools; entries without evidence are treated as not executed

evidence.description: Evidence of execution: an output file path (e.g. docs/test-cases.md) or an output heading line starting with '#'

outputExcerpt.description: Excerpt of the declared tool's actual output text. Must contain that tool's own H1 heading line; otherwise the declaration is reported as evidence-unverified and still counted as not executed

toolName.description: Name of an already executed tool in this workflow

declaredCoverage.description: Coverage figures already claimed in the deliverable, cross-checked against the computed values

documents.description: Test basis documents used to substantiate axis items and to detect defined ids missing from every axis

pairedAxisId.description: Limit the exclusion to the pair with this axis; omit to apply to all pairs

reason.description: Why this item is intentionally allowed to be an empty row/column; leaving it empty is flagged as CMX-07[high]

expectedAxisPopulations.description: Full expected id population per axis, used to detect axis shrinkage that inflates fill rates

idPatterns.description: Extra regular expression sources for requirement/feature IDs, added to the default pattern. Capture group count decides how the ID is built: 1 group = group 1 is used as the whole ID as-is (no hyphen joining), 2 groups = reconstructed as `${group1}-${group2}` (default pattern behavior), 0 groups = the whole match is used. Use a 1-group pattern for numeric-only IDs (031), dot-separated IDs (3.1.2) and underscore IDs (REQ_001) so the reported ID matches the notation in the source document. If a given pattern matches nothing, a [high] finding is emitted in the input digest.

includeCoverageTargetIds.description: Include colon-separated coverage target IDs (BV:/EP:/ST:/DT:/PW:/SC:/UC:/DL:/CFG:) emitted by design_* tools in the ID index. Defaults to true.
